### Fixed

- Fixed inherited Kimi K3 output limits for Vercel AI Gateway and OpenRouter models.
- Fixed cloning or forking a session before its first assistant response to explain that the session must be saved first.

### Removed

- Removed Grok 3, Grok 3 Fast, Grok 4.20 variants, and Grok Code Fast 1 from the built-in xAI model catalog ([#6734](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6734) by [@Jaaneek](https://github.com/Jaaneek)).

- Fixed inherited Kimi K3 output limits for Vercel AI Gateway and OpenRouter models.
- Fixed cloning or forking a session before its first assistant response to explain that the session must be saved first.

sections.title: Removed
sections.body: - Removed Grok 3, Grok 3 Fast, Grok 4.20 variants, and Grok Code Fast 1 from the built-in xAI model catalog ([#6734](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6734) by [@Jaaneek](https://github.com/Jaaneek)).

zh.body:
### 新功能

- **Kimi K3和延迟工具加载** — 可在内置提供商中使用Kimi K3，包括通过Kimi原生协议进行渐进式扩展工具激活。详见[动态工具加载](docs/extensions.md#dynamic-tool-loading)、[OpenAI兼容性](docs/models.md#openai-compatibility)和[`kimi-deferred-tools.ts`](examples/extensions/kimi-deferred-tools.ts)示例。

### 添加

- 为Kimi Coding、Moonshot AI、Moonshot AI China、OpenRouter和Vercel AI Gateway添加继承的Kimi K3支持。
- 为扩展驱动工具激活添加Kimi延迟工具加载。详见[动态工具加载](docs/extensions.md#dynamic-tool-loading)、[OpenAI兼容性](docs/models.md#openai-compatibility)和[`kimi-deferred-tools.ts`](examples/extensions/kimi-deferred-tools.ts)示例。

### 更改

- 将xAI登录改为使用预填设备授权链接，标签为“使用SuperGrok或X Premium登录”，并将默认xAI模型更改为Grok 4.5（[#6734](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6734)由[@Jaaneek](https://github.com/Jaaneek)提交）。

### 修复

- 修复继承的Kimi K3输出限制，使其适用于Vercel AI Gateway和OpenRouter模型。
- 修复在会话首次助手响应前克隆或分叉会话，提示会话必须先保存。

### 移除

- 从内置xAI模型目录移除Grok 3、Grok 3 Fast、Grok 4.20变体和Grok Code Fast 1（[#6734](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6734)由[@Jaaneek](https://github.com/Jaaneek)提交）。

packages.description: 历史包资料；当前工作区没有此包的 package.json。
呈现层：终端组件、输入编辑、自动补全与差分渲染。
产品层：CLI、交互模式、扩展、模型运行时、会话与工具。学习主入口。

en.body:
### New Features

- **Unified model runtime and provider authentication** — `ModelRuntime` centralizes model configuration, provider-owned `/login`, and dynamic provider catalogs. See [Providers](docs/providers.md).
- **Live model catalog refresh** — `/model` refreshes configured providers in the background, and `pi update --models` forces an immediate refresh. See [Install and Manage](docs/packages.md#install-and-manage).
- **xAI device-code OAuth and Grok 4.5 Responses support** — Sign in to xAI with a device code and use Grok 4.5 with low, medium, or high thinking. See [xAI](docs/providers.md#xai-grokx-subscription).

### Breaking Changes

- Replaced the SDK's `CreateAgentSessionOptions.authStorage` and `modelRegistry` options with the async `modelRuntime` option. `AuthStorage` and its storage backends are no longer exported; use `ModelRuntime` (or a custom pi-ai `CredentialStore`), or `readStoredCredential()` for one-off reads of auth.json.
- Removed redundant `ModelRuntime.getAll()`, `find()`, `getSnapshot()`, and `getAuthOptions()` projections. Use the pi-ai `Models` methods `getModels()`, `getModel()`, `getProviders()`, and `checkAuth()` directly.
- Replaced SDK request-auth assembly through `ModelRegistry.getApiKeyAndHeaders()` with `ModelRuntime.getAuth()`. Passing a provider ID returns provider-scoped auth; passing a model also resolves built-in, `models.json`, and extension model headers.
- Changed extension-facing `ModelRegistry.refresh()` from synchronous `void` to `Promise<void>` because `models.json` loading is asynchronous. Extensions must await it before making synchronous registry reads.
- Moved canonical dynamic catalog refresh to async `ModelRuntime.refresh()`/pi-ai `Models.refresh()`. Legacy extension OAuth `modifyModels` remains supported as a synchronous compatibility projection after credential initialization.

### Added

- Added `ModelRuntime` as the canonical async SDK and internal model/auth facade while preserving the synchronous extension-facing `ModelRegistry` API. `ModelRuntime.create()` accepts any pi-ai `CredentialStore` through its `credentials` option.
- Added provider-owned `/login` discovery directly from registered pi-ai providers, including ambient auth status and informational links.
- Added file-backed dynamic catalogs in `models-store.json`, per-provider pi.dev catalog overlays, and Radius gateway support including offline migration from legacy credential-cached catalogs.
- Added extension provider `refreshModels(context)` support for dynamic model discovery with optional provider-controlled persistence.
- Added `pi update --models` to force an immediate model catalog refresh without updating pi or extensions.
- Added inherited xAI device-code OAuth login and Grok 4.5 OpenAI Responses support, with low, medium, and high thinking levels ([#6651](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6651) by [@Jaaneek](https://github.com/Jaaneek)).

### Changed

- Changed `ModelRuntime` to compose built-in providers, immutable `models.json` configuration, and extension overlays through ad-hoc pi-ai provider methods.
- Changed `ModelRuntime` to own final request assembly: `getAuth(model)` includes configured model headers, stream methods resolve auth once, and `before_provider_headers` runs as the Models-only header transform before provider dispatch.
- Changed `/model` to render the current model snapshot immediately, refresh configured providers in the background, and update the open selector with partial results or timeout errors.

### Fixed

- Fixed configured-provider catalog refresh to parse pi.dev's model-ID keyed responses, throttle checks to once per four hours, send the versioned pi user agent, treat unimplemented routes as unavailable overlays, and show concise refresh status in `/model`.
- Fixed adjacent assistant thinking blocks to render as one thinking section.
- Fixed inherited OpenAI Codex session IDs longer than 64 characters to meet the API limit ([#6630](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/issues/6630)).
- Fixed inherited terminal output to normalize tab characters consistently ([#6697](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6697) by [@xz-dev](https://github.com/xz-dev)).
- Fixed the Windows terminal title after checking npm packages ([#6629](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/issues/6629)).
- Fixed Bun standalone binaries to bundle OAuth adapters for interactive logins.

zh.body:
### 新功能

- **统一模型运行时和提供商认证** — `ModelRuntime`集中管理模型配置、提供商拥有的`/login`和动态提供商目录。详见[提供商](docs/providers.md)。
- **实时模型目录刷新** — `/model`在后台刷新已配置的提供商，`pi update --models`强制立即刷新。详见[安装与管理](docs/packages.md#install-and-manage)。
- **xAI设备码OAuth和Grok 4.5响应支持** — 通过设备码登录xAI，并使用Grok 4.5进行低、中、高思维。详见[xAI](docs/providers.md#xai-grokx-subscription)。

### 重大变更

- 用异步`modelRuntime`选项替换SDK的`CreateAgentSessionOptions.authStorage`和`modelRegistry`选项。`AuthStorage`及其存储后端不再导出；使用`ModelRuntime`（或自定义pi-ai `CredentialStore`），或`readStoredCredential()`进行auth.json的一次性读取。
- 移除冗余的`ModelRuntime.getAll()`、`find()`、`getSnapshot()`和`getAuthOptions()`投影。直接使用pi-ai `Models`方法`getModels()`、`getModel()`、`getProviders()`和`checkAuth()`。
- 用`ModelRuntime.getAuth()`替换SDK请求认证组装（通过`ModelRegistry.getApiKeyAndHeaders()`）。传递提供商ID返回范围授权；传递模型也解析内置、`models.json`和扩展模型头。
- 将面向扩展的`ModelRegistry.refresh()`从同步`void`更改为`Promise<void>`，因为`models.json`加载是异步的。扩展必须等待它之后才能进行同步注册表读取。

- 将动态目录刷新的规范移动到异步`ModelRuntime.refresh()`/pi-ai `Models.refresh()`。旧版扩展OAuth `modifyModels`在凭证初始化后仍作为同步兼容性投影支持。

### 添加

- 将`ModelRuntime`作为规范的异步SDK和内部模型/认证门面，同时保留面向扩展的同步`ModelRegistry` API。`ModelRuntime.create()`可通过其`credentials`选项接受任何pi-ai `CredentialStore`。

- 添加了由提供者拥有的`/login`发现，可直接从已注册的pi-ai提供者获取，包括环境认证状态和信息链接。

- 添加了文件支持的动态目录（`models-store.json`），每个提供者的pi.dev目录覆盖层，以及Radius网关支持，包括从旧凭证缓存目录的离线迁移。

- 添加了扩展提供者`refreshModels(context)`对动态模型发现的支持，可选由提供者控制持久化。

- 添加了`pi update --models`，以强制立即刷新模型目录，而不更新pi或扩展。

- 添加了继承的xAI设备码OAuth登录和Grok 4.5 OpenAI响应支持，支持低、中、高思考级别（[#6651](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6651)由[@Jaaneek](https://github.com/Jaaneek)提交）。

### 更改

- 将`ModelRuntime`更改为通过pi-ai提供者方法组合内置提供者、不可变`models.json`配置和扩展覆盖。

- 将`ModelRuntime`更改为拥有最终请求组装：`getAuth(model)`包含已配置的模型头部，流方法在认证后仅解析一次，`before_provider_headers`作为仅模型头部转换运行，然后进行提供者分发。

- 将`/model`更改为立即渲染当前模型快照，在后台刷新已配置提供者，并在部分结果或超时错误时更新开放选择器。
### 修复

- 修复了configured-provider目录刷新，以解析pi.dev的基于model-ID的响应，将检查频率限制为每四小时一次，发送版本化的pi用户代理，将未实现的路由视为不可用的覆盖层，并在`/model`中显示简洁的刷新状态。
- 将相邻的助手思考块固定为一个思考区域。
- 修复了继承的OpenAI Codex会话ID超过64个字符的问题，以满足API限制（[#6630](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/issues/6630)）。
- 修复了终端输出的继承问题，以使制表符字符保持一致（[#6697](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6697) 由 [@xz-dev](https://github.com/xz-dev) 提交）。
- 修复了在检查npm包后Windows终端的标题([#6629](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/issues/6629))。

- 修复了Bun独立二进制文件，使其打包OAuth适配器以支持交互式登录。

- 将`ModelRuntime`更改为拥有最终请求组装：`getAuth(model)`包含已配置的模型头部，流方法在认证后仅解析一次，`before_provider_headers`作为仅模型头部转换运行，然后进行提供者分发。

en.body:
### Breaking Changes

- Changed runtime authentication to provider-scoped `Models.checkAuth()`, `getAuth()`, `login()`, and `logout()` APIs. `checkAuth()` now returns `AuthCheck | undefined`, and API-key auth resolvers no longer receive a model.
- Removed the legacy built-in OAuth provider objects, global OAuth registry APIs, and public low-level built-in login/refresh functions. Use canonical `Provider.auth.oauth` methods instead; the `oauth` subpath now retains only extension compatibility types.
- Renamed the canonical login interaction interface from `AuthLoginCallbacks` to `AuthInteraction`; it exposes the provider-neutral `prompt()`/`notify()` protocol used by API-key and OAuth flows.
- Changed the `Models` request contract: `getAuth(model)` now includes model headers, while `getAuth(providerId)` remains provider-scoped, and Models stream options may include `transformHeaders`. Custom `Models` implementations must execute the transform after merging auth/model and explicit headers, then remove it before provider dispatch.
- Changed dynamic model refresh to `Models.refresh(options)`, which refreshes every configured dynamic provider and returns per-provider errors/cancellation state. `Provider.refreshModels(context)` now receives the effective credential, scoped model storage, network policy, and abort signal.

### Added

- Added provider-owned authentication and availability resolution to `Models`, including stored OAuth refresh and interactive login support through `CredentialStore`.
- Added async non-secret credential enumeration through `CredentialStore.list()` and credential-aware `Provider.filterModels()` availability policy.
- Added neutral auth-flow information/link events and provider-owned Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI credential selection flows.
- Added `ModelsStore` with an in-memory default for restoring and persisting dynamic provider catalogs.
- Added the dynamic Radius `pi-messages` gateway provider with OAuth and credential-specific catalog refresh.
- Added `Models.refresh({ force: true })` to let providers bypass freshness checks for explicit refreshes.
- Added xAI device-code OAuth login and routed Grok 4.5 through OpenAI Responses, with low, medium, and high thinking support ([#6651](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6651) by [@Jaaneek](https://github.com/Jaaneek)).

### Changed

- Changed `Models.getAuth(model)` to include model headers and added a Models-only `transformHeaders` stream option that runs after auth and explicit header assembly but is not forwarded to providers.

### Fixed

- Fixed Cloudflare Workers AI and AI Gateway streams to materialize account and gateway endpoint placeholders after auth resolution, including compat streaming with custom model objects.
- Fixed lazy provider streams to preserve their final assistant message when forwarding an inner stream.
- Fixed OpenAI Codex session IDs longer than 64 characters to meet the API limit ([#6630](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/issues/6630)).

zh.body:
### 重大变更

- 将运行时认证改为提供方作用域的`Models.checkAuth()`、`getAuth()`、`login()`和`logout()` API。`checkAuth()`现在返回`AuthCheck | undefined`，且API密钥认证解析器不再接收模型。
- 移除遗留的内置OAuth提供方对象、全局OAuth注册表API及公开的低级内置登录/刷新函数。建议使用标准`Provider.auth.oauth`方法；`oauth`子路径仅保留扩展兼容类型。
- 将标准登录交互接口从`AuthLoginCallbacks`重命名为`AuthInteraction`；它暴露了由API密钥和OAuth流程使用的提供方中立的`prompt()`/`notify()`协议。
- 修改`Models`请求契约：`getAuth(model)`现在包含模型头部，`getAuth(providerId)`仍为提供方作用域，且模型流选项可能包含`transformHeaders`。自定义`Models`实现必须在合并认证/模型和显式头部后执行转换，然后在提供方分发前移除。
- 将动态模型刷新改为`Models.refresh(options)`，该功能会刷新所有已配置的动态提供方并返回各提供方的错误/取消状态。`Provider.refreshModels(context)`现在接收有效凭证、作用域模型存储、网络策略和取消信号。
### 新增

- 新增了`Models`的提供商自有认证和可用性解析功能，包括通过`CredentialStore`支持的OAuth刷新和交互式登录。

- 新增了通过`CredentialStore.list()`的异步非机密凭证枚举功能和基于凭证的`Provider.filterModels()`可用性策略。

- 新增了中立认证流程信息/链接事件以及提供商自有Amazon Bedrock和Google Vertex AI凭证选择流程。

- 新增了`ModelsStore`，包含内存默认值，用于恢复和持久化动态提供商目录。

- 新增了动态Radius `pi-messages`网关提供商，支持OAuth和基于凭证的目录刷新。

- 新增了`Models.refresh({ force: true })`，允许提供商在显式刷新时绕过新鲜度检查。

- 新增了xAI设备码OAuth登录，并将Grok 4.5路由至OpenAI Responses，支持低、中、高思考模式（[#6651](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6651) 由 [@Jaaneek](https://github.com/Jaaneek) 提交）。

### 更改

- 将`Models.getAuth(model)`更改为包含模型头，并新增了仅限模型的`transformHeaders`流选项，该选项在认证和显式头部组装后运行，但不会转发给提供商。

### 修复

- 修复了Cloudflare Workers AI和AI网关流，使其在认证解析后填充账户和网关端点占位符，兼容自定义模型对象的流式传输。

- 修复了懒加载提供商流，在转发内层流时保留其最终助手消息。

- 修复了OpenAI Codex会话ID超过64字符的问题，以符合API限制（[#6630](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/issues/6630)）。

en.body:
### Breaking Changes

- Removed the `openai-responses` `compat.sendSessionIdHeader` flag from `models.json`. Session-affinity behavior is now controlled by `compat.sessionAffinityFormat` (`"openai"`, `"openai-nosession"`, or `"openrouter"`). Replace `sendSessionIdHeader: false` with `sessionAffinityFormat: "openai-nosession"` ([#6496](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6496) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll)).

### New Features

- **Cache-friendly dynamic tool loading** - Extensions can add tools during execution while supported Anthropic and OpenAI Responses models preserve prompt-cache prefixes. See [Dynamic Tool Loading](docs/extensions.md#dynamic-tool-loading).
- **Message copy shortcut** - `Ctrl+X` copies the last assistant message in the transcript or the selected message in `/tree`, making older and branched messages directly copyable. See [Display and Message Queue](docs/keybindings.md#display-and-message-queue).
- **Fable 5 `xhigh` and `max` thinking** - Native `xhigh` and `max` thinking levels are available across generated provider catalogs. See [Model Options](docs/usage.md#model-options).

### Added

- Added cache-friendly dynamic tool loading for extension tools activated by tool results. Supported Anthropic and OpenAI Responses models load definitions where they become available, preserving the cached prompt prefix. See [Dynamic Tool Loading](docs/extensions.md#dynamic-tool-loading) ([#6474](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6474)).
- Added inherited native `xhigh` and `max` thinking levels for Claude Fable 5 across all generated provider catalogs ([#6490](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6490) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Added `Ctrl+X` to copy the last assistant message, or the selected message in `/tree`.
- Added inherited `toolChoice` support for OpenAI and Codex Responses, including required and named tool selection ([#6588](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6588) by [@xl0](https://github.com/xl0)).

### Fixed

- Fixed inherited OpenRouter model context windows to use the top provider's actual context length ([#6481](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6481) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed inherited OpenRouter OpenAI-compatible session IDs to use the `x-session-id` header instead of OpenAI-specific session-affinity fields ([#6496](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6496) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll)).
- Fixed `Ctrl+V` to paste clipboard text when the pasteboard does not contain an image.
- Fixed `/login amazon-bedrock` to prompt for and save a Bedrock API key instead of only displaying ambient AWS credential setup instructions.
- Fixed inherited Amazon Bedrock ambient AWS credentials to keep using SigV4 authentication, including for custom model IDs ([#6532](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6532) by [@ribelo](https://github.com/ribelo)).
- Fixed inherited Cloudflare Workers AI and AI Gateway authentication to use ambient account and gateway IDs when stored credentials contain only an API key ([#6292](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6292) by [@markphelps](https://github.com/markphelps)).
- Fixed inherited legacy terminal decoding for Alt+symbol key combinations such as `Alt+,` and `Alt+.` ([#6523](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6523) by [@ribelo](https://github.com/ribelo)).
- Fixed the GitHub Copilot `mai-code-1-flash-picker` model to route through the `/responses` endpoint ([#6544](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6544) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll)).
- Fixed branch summaries to work with providers that use ambient authentication instead of API keys ([#6595](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6595) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed inherited Amazon Bedrock errors to report unhandled provider stop reasons instead of only `An unknown error occurred` ([#6598](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6598) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed npm package removal when installed packages have conflicting peer dependencies ([#6604](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6604) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed inherited Azure OpenAI Responses reasoning replay when `encrypted_content` appears only in the terminal response event ([#6608](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6608) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed inherited Anthropic-compatible proxies that omit `usage` from `message_delta` events ([#6611](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6611) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed inherited OpenCode OpenAI Responses models to omit the unsupported `session-id` header while preserving other cache-affinity data ([#6645](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6645) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed system prompt cache invalidation across dates by removing the current date from the default prompt ([#6621](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6621)).

### 不兼容变更
- 已从`models.json`中移除`openai-responses`和`compat.sendSessionIdHeader`标志。会话关联行为现在由`compat.sessionAffinityFormat`（`"openai"`， `"openai-nosession"`，或 `"openrouter"`)。将 `sendSessionIdHeader: false` 替换为 `sessionAffinityFormat: "openai-nosession"` ([#6496](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6496) 由 [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll) 提交)。
### 新功能

- **缓存友好的动态工具加载** - 扩展程序可在执行过程中添加工具，同时支持Anthropic和OpenAI响应模型会保留提示缓存前缀。详见[动态工具加载](docs/extensions.md#dynamic-tool-loading)。
- **消息复制快捷方式** - `Ctrl+X`会复制对话记录中的最后一条助手消息，或在`/tree`中选中的消息，使较早或分支消息可直接复制。详见[显示与消息队列](docs/keybindings.md#display-and-message-queue)。
- **Fable 5 `xhigh`和`max`思考** - 生成器目录中支持原生`xhigh`和`max`思考等级。详见[模型选项](docs/usage.md#model-options)。

### 已添加
- 增加了针对由工具结果激活的扩展工具的缓存友好型动态工具加载。支持Anthropic和OpenAI响应模型加载定义在可用时加载，保持缓存的提示词前缀。详见[动态工具加载](docs/extensions.md#dynamic-tool-loading) ([#6474](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6474))。

- 增加了对Claude Fable 5的继承原生`xhigh`和`max`思考层级的支持，覆盖所有生成式提供商目录 ([#6490](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6490) 由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交)。

- 增加了`Ctrl+X`以复制最后一条助手消息，或在`/tree`中复制选定的消息。

- 增加了对OpenAI和Codex响应的继承`toolChoice`支持，包括必需和命名工具选择 ([#6588](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6588) 由[@xl0](https://github.com/xl0)提交)。

### 修复

- 修复了继承的OpenRouter模型上下文窗口，使其使用顶级提供商的实际上下文长度 ([#6481](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6481) 由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交)。

- 修复了继承的OpenRouter OpenAI兼容会话ID，使其使用`x-session-id`头部，而非OpenAI特定的会话关联字段 ([#6496](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6496) 由[@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll)提交)。

- 修复了`Ctrl+V`在剪贴板不包含图片时粘贴剪贴板文本。

- 修复了`/login amazon-bedrock`，在提示并保存Bedrock API密钥时，而非仅显示环境AWS凭证设置说明。

- 修复了继承的Amazon Bedrock环境AWS凭证，使其继续使用SigV4认证，包括对自定义模型ID的支持 ([#6532](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6532) 由[@ribelo](https://github.com/ribelo)提交)。

- 修复了继承的Cloudflare Workers AI和AI Gateway认证，使其在存储凭证仅包含API密钥时，使用环境账户和网关ID ([#6292](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6292) 由[@markphelps](https://github.com/markphelps)提交)。

- 修复了继承的旧终端解码，针对Alt+符号键组合（如`Alt+,`和`Alt+.`）的处理 ([#6523](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6523) 由[@ribelo](https://github.com/ribelo)提交)。

- 修复了GitHub Copilot的`mai-code-1-flash-picker`模型，使其通过`/responses`端点路由 ([#6544](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6544) 由[@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll)提交)。

- 修复了分支摘要，使其与使用环境认证而非API密钥的提供商兼容 ([#6595](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6595) 由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交)。

- 修复了继承的Amazon Bedrock错误，使其报告未处理的提供商停止原因，而非仅`An unknown error occurred` ([#6598](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6598) 由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交)。

- 修复了npm包移除，当已安装包存在冲突的同伴依赖时 ([#6604](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6604) 由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交)。

- 修复了继承的Azure OpenAI响应推理回放，当`encrypted_content`仅出现在终端响应事件中时 ([#6608](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6608) 由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交)。

- 修复了继承的Anthropic兼容代理，使其在`message_delta`事件中包含`usage` ([#6611](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6611) 由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交)。

- 修复了继承的OpenCode OpenAI响应模型，使其省略不支持的`session-id`头部，同时保持其他缓存亲和力数据 ([#6645](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6645) 由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交)。

- 修复了系统提示词缓存失效，通过从默认提示词中移除当前日期实现跨日期缓存 ([#6621](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6621))。

en.body:
### Breaking Changes

- Removed the `OpenAIResponsesCompat.sendSessionIdHeader` flag. Session-affinity behavior is now controlled by `compat.sessionAffinityFormat` (`"openai"`, `"openai-nosession"`, or `"openrouter"`). Replace `sendSessionIdHeader: false` with `sessionAffinityFormat: "openai-nosession"` ([#6496](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6496) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll)).

### Added

- Added cache-friendly dynamic tool loading. `ToolResultMessage.addedToolNames` marks where tools from `Context.tools` became available; Anthropic and OpenAI Responses use native deferred loading so late tools stay out of the cached prefix, while other providers continue using `Context.tools` normally ([#6474](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6474)).
- Added native `xhigh` and `max` thinking levels for Claude Fable 5 across all generated provider catalogs ([#6490](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6490) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Added `toolChoice` support to OpenAI and Codex Responses, including required and named tool selection ([#6588](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6588) by [@xl0](https://github.com/xl0)).

### Fixed

- Fixed OpenRouter model context windows to use the top provider's actual context length ([#6481](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6481) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed the GitHub Copilot `mai-code-1-flash-picker` model to route through the `/responses` endpoint ([#6544](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6544) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll)).
- Fixed Amazon Bedrock requests to use the generic `apiKey` stream option as a Bedrock bearer token.
- Fixed OpenRouter OpenAI-compatible session IDs to use the `x-session-id` header instead of OpenAI-specific session-affinity fields ([#6496](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6496) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll)).
- Fixed Amazon Bedrock ambient AWS credentials to keep using SigV4 authentication, including for custom model IDs ([#6532](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6532) by [@ribelo](https://github.com/ribelo)).
- Fixed Cloudflare Workers AI and AI Gateway authentication to use ambient account and gateway IDs when stored credentials contain only an API key ([#6292](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6292) by [@markphelps](https://github.com/markphelps)).
- Fixed Amazon Bedrock errors to report unhandled provider stop reasons instead of only `An unknown error occurred` ([#6598](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6598) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed Azure OpenAI Responses reasoning replay when `encrypted_content` appears only in the terminal response event ([#6608](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6608) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed Anthropic-compatible proxies that omit `usage` from `message_delta` events ([#6611](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6611) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed OpenCode OpenAI Responses models to omit the unsupported `session-id` header while preserving other cache-affinity data ([#6645](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/pull/6645) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).

en.body:
### New Features

- **`max` thinking level** - New opt-in thinking level above `xhigh`, natively supported on GPT-5.6 and adaptive Claude models, available across CLI (`--thinking max`), SDK, RPC, and model selection. Custom themes can define `thinkingMax`. See [CLI Reference](docs/usage.md#cli-reference).
- **Input-based pricing tiers** - Request-wide input-token pricing tiers for accurate long-context cost accounting (e.g. GPT-5.4/5.5/5.6 long-context rates), also configurable for custom models in `models.json` and `modelOverrides`. See [Model Configuration](docs/models.md#model-configuration).

### Added

- Added the opt-in `max` thinking level across CLI, SDK, RPC, model selection, and themes. Custom themes can define `thinkingMax`; existing themes fall back to `thinkingXhigh`.
- Added request-wide input-token pricing tiers to custom model costs in `models.json`, `modelOverrides`, and extension-registered providers.
- Added `~` (home directory) expansion for the `shellPath` setting ([#6470](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6470) by [@aaronkyriesenbach](https://github.com/aaronkyriesenbach)).

### Fixed

- Fixed inherited post-compaction output-token budgeting to ignore stale assistant usage from before the compaction boundary ([#6464](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6464)).
- Fixed inherited GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 long-context cost accounting while retaining the intentional 272K default context limit for models that require an explicit override.
- Fixed inherited GPT-5.6 metadata to keep direct OpenAI requests in the 272K short-context tier while exposing the Codex backend's 372K context window with long-context pricing, and removed the nonexistent bare `gpt-5.6` alias.
- Fixed inherited Anthropic message conversion to preserve thinking blocks with empty thinking text but a valid signature instead of dropping them, avoiding thinking-block errors on newer Claude models ([#6457](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6457) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).

### 新增功能

- **`max`思考层级** - 新增可选的思考层级，位于`xhigh`之上，原生支持于GPT-5.6和自适应Claude模型，可在CLI（`--thinking max`）、SDK、RPC和模型选择中使用。自定义主题可定义`thinkingMax`。详见[CLI参考](docs/usage.md#cli-reference)。

- **基于输入的定价层级** - 支持请求范围内的输入令牌定价层级，用于准确的长上下文成本核算（例如GPT-5.4/5.5/5.6长上下文费率），也可在`models.json`和`modelOverrides`中为自定义模型配置。详见[模型配置](docs/models.md#model-configuration)。

### 增加了

- 增加了可选的`max`思考层级，覆盖CLI、SDK、RPC、模型选择和主题。自定义主题可定义`thinkingMax`；现有主题回退至`thinkingXhigh`。
- 增加了请求范围的input-token定价层级，应用于`models.json`、`modelOverrides`以及已注册扩展提供商的自定义模型成本。
- 增加了`~`（主目录）的扩展，用于`shellPath`设置（[#6470](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6470) 由 [@aaronkyriesenbach](https://github.com/aaronkyriesenbach) 提交）。

### 修复

- 修复了继承式压缩后输出-token预算计算，使其忽略压缩边界前的过期助手使用情况（[#6464](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6464)）。
- 修复了继承式GPT-5.4和GPT-5.5长上下文成本核算，同时保留了对需要显式覆盖的模型默认272K上下文限制的有意设定。
- 修复了继承式GPT-5.6元数据，使其在短上下文层级保留直接OpenAI请求的同时，暴露Codex后端的372K上下文窗口及长上下文定价，并移除了不存在的裸`gpt-5.6`别名。
- 修复了继承式Anthropic消息转换，使其保留带有有效签名但思考文本为空的思考区块，避免在新版Claude模型中出现思考区块错误（[#6457](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6457) 由 [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai) 提交）。

### New Features

- **Prompt cache miss visibility** - Significant cache misses can be shown in transcripts via `showCacheMissNotices`. See [Model & Thinking](docs/settings.md#model--thinking).
- **Project-local resource configuration** - `pi config -l` and Tab switching manage global vs project-local package resources. See [Enable and Disable Resources](docs/packages.md#enable-and-disable-resources).
- **Extension lifecycle and provider hooks** - Extensions get `agent_settled`, `before_provider_headers`, entry renderers, and `InlineExtension`. See [agent_start / agent_end / agent_settled](docs/extensions.md#agent_start--agent_end--agent_settled), [before_provider_headers](docs/extensions.md#before_provider_headers), and [InlineExtension](docs/sdk.md#inlineextension).
- **New inherited model and transport support** - GPT-5.6 metadata, Copilot Claude Sonnet 5, and zstd Codex SSE transport are available through inherited provider support. See [Providers](docs/providers.md) and [Model Options](docs/usage.md#model-options).

### Added

- Added inherited OpenAI GPT-5.6 model metadata for `gpt-5.6`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, and `gpt-5.6-luna`, plus verified `openai-codex` support for `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, and `gpt-5.6-luna`.
- Added inherited Claude Sonnet 5 to the GitHub Copilot model catalog ([#6200](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6200)).
- Added inherited zstd request-body compression for the OpenAI Codex Responses SSE transport.
- Added `/login <provider>` support with provider autocomplete.
- Added public SDK exports for CLI-equivalent model and scoped-model resolution ([#6201](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6201)).
- Added extension and RPC `agent_settled` events plus session-level idle waiting for fully settled agent runs ([#6363](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6363)).
- Added `before_provider_headers` extension hook support for injecting provider request headers ([#6350](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6350) by [@pmateusz](https://github.com/pmateusz)).
- Added an `InlineExtension` type for named inline extension factories ([#6267](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6267) by [@any-victor](https://github.com/any-victor)).
- Added extension entry renderers for persisted display-only session entries that are rendered in interactive mode without being sent to the model context.
- Added project-local resource override management to `pi config`, including project mode startup with `pi config -l` and Tab switching between global and project scopes ([#6309](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6309)).
- Added inherited `InMemorySessionStorage` and `JsonlSessionStorage` exports from the agent harness ([#6435](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6435)).
- Added inherited custom metadata support in JSONL session headers ([#6417](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6417) by [@ArcadiaLin](https://github.com/ArcadiaLin)).
- Added a `showCacheMissNotices` setting and `/settings` toggle for significant prompt-cache miss transcript notices.

### Fixed

- Fixed inherited retry classification for gRPC `ResourceExhausted` provider errors such as NVIDIA NIM transient exhaustion responses ([#6449](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6449) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed inherited retry classification for Cloudflare 524 timeout responses ([#6239](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6239)).
- Fixed inherited GitHub Copilot device-code login polling to wait before the first token poll and to honor server-provided `slow_down` intervals, avoiding incorrect failures or apparent hangs after browser authorization ([#6187](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6187)).
- Fixed inherited OpenAI Codex WebSocket sessions to rotate cached connections before the backend's 60-minute limit, avoiding connection-limit failures on long sessions ([#6268](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6268)).
- Fixed inherited DS4 server context overflow detection for `Prompt has ... tokens, but the configured context size is ... tokens` errors ([#6262](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6262)).
- Fixed inherited Fireworks GLM 5.2 Fast to use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and `thinkingLevelMap`, aligning it with GLM 5.2 ([#6195](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6195)).
- Fixed the fork menu to ignore duplicate selection of the same entry ([#6430](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6430) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed native clipboard support in Bun standalone releases ([#6418](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6418) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed inherited GitHub Copilot extended context window models to use `contextWindow: 1000000`, preventing premature compaction and under-budgeting ([#6439](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6439)).
- Fixed inherited editor paste marker accounting when paste markers are deleted or terminal state is cleared ([#6397](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6397) by [@affanali2k3](https://github.com/affanali2k3)).
- Fixed `null` message content from imported transcripts or custom clients to normalize at ingestion boundaries instead of failing during context construction ([#6343](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6343)).
- Fixed inherited tool calls from length-truncated assistant messages to fail instead of waiting for missing tool results ([#6285](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6285)).
- Fixed inherited OpenAI Completions and Responses providers to send `(no tool output)` instead of `(see attached image)` when a tool result has empty text and no image content.
- Fixed inherited OpenAI Responses and Azure OpenAI Responses requests to avoid sending `max_output_tokens` values below the provider minimum ([#6265](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6265)).
- Fixed inherited Amazon Bedrock prompt-cache points for Claude Fable 5 and Claude Sonnet 5 ([#6235](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6235)).
- Fixed inherited Amazon Bedrock Claude 5 prompt-cache pricing metadata by removing stale fallback overrides.
- Fixed inherited OpenAI Codex user-agent construction to synchronously load Node OS metadata, avoiding a startup race that could report `pi (browser)` in Node/Bun.
- Fixed `pi update` for pnpm installations to suggest pruning pnpm's self-update cache when the executable points at a removed cached version ([#6279](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6279) by [@rajp152k](https://github.com/rajp152k)).
- Fixed Xiaomi Token Plan model metadata to follow the upstream models.dev token-plan catalogs, removing unsupported `mimo-v2-omni` variants ([#6204](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6204)).
- Fixed startup model selection to skip unauthenticated saved defaults so configured local custom models can be selected instead ([#6231](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6231)).
- Fixed the question extension example to run question tool calls sequentially so multiple questions in one assistant turn remain answerable ([#6189](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6189)).
- Fixed `/login` to report auth storage persistence failures instead of claiming credentials were saved when `auth.json` is locked ([#6223](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6223)).
- Fixed split-turn compaction to serialize summary requests so single-concurrency local providers do not fail with 429 errors ([#5536](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5536)).
- Fixed compaction retained-token budgeting to count context-visible custom messages ([#6326](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6326)).
- Fixed custom session entries appended during assistant streaming to render before the live assistant message, matching persisted session order.
- Fixed non-positive or oversized bash tool timeouts to fail with a clear validation error instead of being clamped to an immediate timeout ([#6181](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6181)).
- Fixed the edit tool schema to allow model-invented extra replacement fields instead of rejecting otherwise valid edits ([#6278](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6278)).
- Fixed new session resets to clear cached label timestamps ([#6354](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6354)).
- Fixed auto-retry for Bun fetch socket-drop errors reported as `socket connection was closed`, so transient provider disconnects do not end headless runs without retrying ([#6431](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6431)).
- Fixed `models.json` `modelOverrides` to apply to extension-registered provider models ([#6367](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6367)).
- Fixed project context file discovery to use stable parent traversal on Windows so startup no longer hangs while loading AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md ([#6369](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6369)).
- Fixed `--session-id` startup to warn when no existing project session has that id and pi creates a new session ([#6407](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6407)).
- Fixed `/reload` help text and docs to consistently mention themes and context files ([#6395](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6395)).

### Removed

- Removed default attribution headers from Vercel AI Gateway requests.

sections.title: New Features
sections.body:
- **Prompt cache miss visibility** - Significant cache misses can be shown in transcripts via `showCacheMissNotices`. See [Model & Thinking](docs/settings.md#model--thinking).
- **Project-local resource configuration** - `pi config -l` and Tab switching manage global vs project-local package resources. See [Enable and Disable Resources](docs/packages.md#enable-and-disable-resources).
- **Extension lifecycle and provider hooks** - Extensions get `agent_settled`, `before_provider_headers`, entry renderers, and `InlineExtension`. See [agent_start / agent_end / agent_settled](docs/extensions.md#agent_start--agent_end--agent_settled), [before_provider_headers](docs/extensions.md#before_provider_headers), and [InlineExtension](docs/sdk.md#inlineextension).
- **New inherited model and transport support** - GPT-5.6 metadata, Copilot Claude Sonnet 5, and zstd Codex SSE transport are available through inherited provider support. See [Providers](docs/providers.md) and [Model Options](docs/usage.md#model-options).

zh.body:
### 新增功能

- **提示缓存未命中可见性** - 重要的缓存未命中可在转录中通过`showCacheMissNotices`显示。详见[模型与思考](docs/settings.md#model--thinking)。
- **项目本地资源配置** - `pi config -l`和Tab切换管理全局与项目本地包资源。详见[启用与禁用资源](docs/packages.md#enable-and-disable-resources)。
- **扩展生命周期和提供商钩子** - 扩展支持`agent_settled`、`before_provider_headers`、入口渲染器和`InlineExtension`。详见[agent_start / agent_end / agent_settled](docs/extensions.md#agent_start--agent_end--agent_settled)、[before_provider_headers](docs/extensions.md#before_provider_headers)和[InlineExtension](docs/sdk.md#inlineextension)。
- **新增继承式模型和传输支持** - GPT-5.6元数据、Copilot Claude Sonnet 5和zstd Codex SSE传输可通过继承式提供商支持获得。详见[提供商](docs/providers.md)和[模型选项](docs/usage.md#model-options)。

### 增加了

- 增加了继承式OpenAI GPT-5.6模型元数据，支持`gpt-5.6`、`gpt-5.6-sol`、`gpt-5.6-terra`和`gpt-5.6-luna`，同时验证了`openai-codex`对`gpt-5.6-sol`、`gpt-5.6-terra`和`gpt-5.6-luna`的支持。
- 增加了继承式Claude Sonnet 5至GitHub Copilot模型目录（[#6200](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6200)）。
- 增加了继承式zstd请求体压缩，用于OpenAI Codex响应的SSE传输。
- 增加了`/login <provider>`提供商自动补全支持。
- 增加了CLI等效的模型和作用域模型解析的公共SDK导出（[#6201](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6201)）。
- 增加了扩展和RPC的`agent_settled`事件及会话级空闲等待，用于完全就绪的代理运行（[#6363](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6363)）。
- 增加了`before_provider_headers`扩展钩子支持，用于注入提供商请求头（[#6350](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6350) 由 [@pmateusz](https://github.com/pmateusz) 提交）。
- 增加了`InlineExtension`类型，用于命名内联扩展工厂（[#6267](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6267) 由 [@any-victor](https://github.com/any-victor) 提交）。
- 增加了扩展入口渲染器，用于持久化仅显示会话条目，在交互模式下渲染而不发送至模型上下文。
- 增加了项目本地资源覆盖管理至`pi config`，包括项目模式启动（`pi config -l`）和Tab切换（全局与项目范围）（[#6309](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6309)）。
- 增加了继承式`InMemorySessionStorage`和`JsonlSessionStorage`导出，来自代理框架（[#6435](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6435)）。
- 增加了继承式JSONL会话头的自定义元数据支持（[#6417](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6417) 由 [@ArcadiaLin](https://github.com/ArcadiaLin) 提交）。
- 增加了一个`showCacheMissNotices`设置和`/settings`切换，用于显著提示缓存未命中转录通知。

### 修复

- 修复了继承式gRPC `ResourceExhausted`提供商错误的重试分类，例如NVIDIA NIM瞬时耗尽响应（[#6449](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6449) 由 [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai) 提交）。
- 修复了对Cloudflare 524超时响应的继承重试分类问题（[#6239](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6239)）。
- 修复了对GitHub Copilot设备码登录轮询的继承处理，使其在首次令牌轮询前等待，并尊重服务器提供的`slow_down`间隔，避免浏览器授权后出现错误或挂起的假象（[#6187](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6187)）。
- 修复了对OpenAI Codex WebSocket会话的继承处理，使其在后端60分钟限制前轮换缓存连接，避免长时间会话出现连接限制失败（[#6268](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6268)）。
- 修复了对DS4服务器上下文溢出检测的继承处理，以处理`Prompt has ... tokens, but the configured context size is ... tokens`错误（[#6262](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6262)）。
- 修复了对Fireworks GLM 5.2 Fast的继承处理，使其使用兼容OpenAI的端点和`thinkingLevelMap`，并与GLM 5.2保持一致（[#6195](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6195)）。
- 修复了分叉菜单忽略对同一入口重复选择的问题（[#6430](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6430)由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交）。
- 修复了Bun独立发布版中的原生剪贴板支持（[#6418](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6418)由[@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)提交）。
- 修复了对GitHub Copilot扩展上下文窗口模型的继承处理，使其使用`contextWindow: 1000000`，防止过早压缩和预算不足（[#6439](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6439)）。
- 修复了对编辑器粘贴标记会计的继承处理，当粘贴标记被删除或终端状态被清除时（[#6397](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6397)由[@affanali2k3](https://github.com/affanali2k3)提交）。
- 修复了`null`消息内容从导入的转录或自定义客户端中获取时，在摄入边界处进行规范化处理，而不是在上下文构建过程中失败（[#6343](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6343)）。
- 修复了对继承工具调用的处理，当助手消息被截断时，工具调用应失败而不是等待缺失的工具结果（[#6285](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6285)）。
- 修复了对OpenAI完成和响应提供程序的继承处理，当工具结果包含空文本且无图像内容时，应发送`(no tool output)`而不是`(see attached image)`。
- 修复了对OpenAI响应和Azure OpenAI响应请求的继承处理，避免发送低于提供程序最小值的`max_output_tokens`（[#6265](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6265)）。
- 修复了继承自Amazon Bedrock的Claude Fable 5和Claude Sonnet 5的prompt-cache点位问题（[#6235](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6235)）。
- 修复了继承自Amazon Bedrock的Claude 5的prompt-cache价格元数据，移除了过期的备用覆盖项。
- 修复了继承自OpenAI Codex的用户代理构建，使其能够同步加载Node OS元数据，避免启动时可能出现的与`pi (browser)`相关的竞态条件（在Node/Bun中）。
- 修复了`pi update`在pnpm安装中的问题，建议在可执行文件指向已移除缓存版本时修剪pnpm的自更新缓存（[#6279](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6279)由[@rajp152k](https://github.com/rajp152k)提交）。
- 修复了Xiaomi Token Plan模型元数据，使其遵循上游models.dev的token-plan目录，移除了不支持的`mimo-v2-omni`变体（[#6204](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6204)）。
- 修复了启动模型选择，跳过未认证的默认值，以便配置的本地自定义模型可以被选择（[#6231](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6231)）。
- 修复了问题扩展示例，使其能够顺序运行问题工具调用，从而确保同一助理轮询中多个问题仍可被回答（[#6189](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6189)）。
- 修复了`/login`，使其在`auth.json`被锁定时报告认证存储持久性失败，而非声称凭证已保存（[#6223](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6223)）。
- 修复了分轮压缩，使其能够序列化摘要请求，避免单并发本地提供程序在429错误下失败（[#5536](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5536)）。
- 修复了压缩保留令牌预算，使其能够计算上下文可见的自定义消息（[#6326](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6326)）。
- 修复了在助理流式传输期间追加的自定义会话条目，使其在实时助理消息之前渲染，与持久化会话顺序保持一致。
- 修复了非正值或过大bash工具超时，使其在被立即超时限制前会返回清晰的验证错误（[#6181](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6181)）。
- 修复了编辑工具模式，允许模型自行发明额外的替换字段，而非拒绝其他有效的编辑（[#6278](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6278)）。
- 修复了新会话重置以清除缓存的标签时间戳的问题（[#6354](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6354)）。
- 修复了Bun获取套接字断开错误（报告为`socket connection was closed`）的自动重试，这样短暂的提供商断开连接就不会在没有重试的情况下结束无头运行（[#6431](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6431)）。
- 修复了`models.json`和`modelOverrides`，使其适用于已注册的扩展提供商模型（[#6367](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6367)）。
- 修复了项目上下文文件发现，在Windows上使用稳定的父级遍历，因此启动时不再因加载AGENTS.md或CLAUDE.md而挂起（[#6369](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6369)）。
- 修复了`--session-id`启动时的警告，当没有现有项目会话具有该ID且pi创建了新会话时（[#6407](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6407)）。
- 修复了`/reload`帮助文本和文档，使其始终提及主题和上下文文件（[#6395](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6395)）。

### 移除了

- 移除了Vercel AI网关请求中的默认归属头。

sections.title: 新增功能
sections.body:
- **提示缓存未命中可见性** - 重要的缓存未命中可在转录中通过`showCacheMissNotices`显示。详见[模型与思考](docs/settings.md#model--thinking)。
- **项目本地资源配置** - `pi config -l`和Tab切换管理全局与项目本地包资源。详见[启用与禁用资源](docs/packages.md#enable-and-disable-resources)。
- **扩展生命周期和提供商钩子** - 扩展支持`agent_settled`、`before_provider_headers`、入口渲染器和`InlineExtension`。详见[agent_start / agent_end / agent_settled](docs/extensions.md#agent_start--agent_end--agent_settled)、[before_provider_headers](docs/extensions.md#before_provider_headers)和[InlineExtension](docs/sdk.md#inlineextension)。
- **新增继承式模型和传输支持** - GPT-5.6元数据、Copilot Claude Sonnet 5和zstd Codex SSE传输可通过继承式提供商支持获得。详见[提供商](docs/providers.md)和[模型选项](docs/usage.md#model-options)。

sections.title: 增加了

en.body:
### Added

- Added configurable harness session context entry transforms and custom-entry message projectors.
- Added custom metadata support in JSONL session headers ([#6417](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6417) by [@ArcadiaLin](https://github.com/ArcadiaLin)).
- Exported `InMemorySessionStorage` and `JsonlSessionStorage` ([#6435](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6435)).

### Fixed

- Fixed harness split-turn compaction to serialize summary requests so single-concurrency providers are not asked to run overlapping generations ([#5536](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5536)).
- Fixed harness tool calls from length-truncated assistant messages to fail instead of waiting for missing tool results ([#6285](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6285)).
- Fixed harness session ingestion to normalize `null` message content before context projection, avoiding crashes on lax imported transcripts ([#6343](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6343)).
- Fixed non-positive or oversized harness shell execution timeouts to fail with a clear validation error instead of being clamped to an immediate timeout ([#6181](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6181)).
- Fixed harness session storage short entry ids to use the random tail of the generated uuidv7 instead of the timestamp prefix, which was nearly constant between calls ([#6242](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6242)).

packages.description: 模型层：统一消息、模型能力、流式事件、提供商接入与模型目录。

en.body:
### Fixed

- Fixed retry classification for gRPC `ResourceExhausted` provider errors such as NVIDIA NIM transient exhaustion responses ([#6449](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6449) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
- Fixed low-level message transformation to normalize `null` message content before provider conversion, avoiding crashes on lax imported transcripts ([#6343](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6343)).
- Fixed Xiaomi Token Plan model metadata to follow the upstream models.dev token-plan catalogs, removing unsupported `mimo-v2-omni` variants ([#6204](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6204)).
- Fixed GitHub Copilot device-code login polling to wait before the first token poll, avoiding incorrect device-code failures for some users after browser authorization ([#6187](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6187)).
- Fixed OAuth device-code polling to honor the server-provided `slow_down` interval instead of only applying the RFC 8628 5-second increment, so GitHub Copilot login recovers instead of appearing to hang when polls arrive early (e.g. WSL/VM clock drift) ([#6187](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6187)).
- Fixed OpenAI Codex user-agent construction to synchronously load Node OS metadata, avoiding a startup race that could report `pi (browser)` in Node/Bun.
- Fixed Fireworks GLM 5.2 Fast to use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and `thinkingLevelMap`, aligning it with GLM 5.2 ([#6195](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6195)).
- Fixed Amazon Bedrock prompt-cache points for Claude Fable 5 and Claude Sonnet 5 ([#6235](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6235)).
- Fixed Amazon Bedrock Claude 5 prompt-cache pricing metadata by removing stale fallback overrides.
- Fixed DS4 server context overflow detection for `Prompt has ... tokens, but the configured context size is ... tokens` errors ([#6262](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6262)).
- Fixed OpenAI Codex WebSocket sessions to rotate cached connections before the backend's 60-minute limit, avoiding connection-limit failures on long sessions ([#6268](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6268)).
- Fixed Cloudflare Workers AI / AI Gateway auth to fall back to the ambient `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` (and `CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_ID`) when the stored credential carries only the API key, so `/login`-style key-only credentials no longer leave the `{CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}` placeholder unresolved and return 404 ([#6021](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6021)).
- Fixed OpenAI Completions and Responses providers to send `(no tool output)` instead of `(see attached image)` when a tool result has empty text and no image content, preventing the model from hallucinating image attachments.
- Fixed OpenAI Responses and Azure OpenAI Responses requests to avoid sending `max_output_tokens` values below the provider minimum ([#6265](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6265)).
- Fixed retry classification for Cloudflare 524 timeout responses ([#6239](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6239)).
- Fixed retry classification for Bun fetch socket-drop errors such as `socket connection was closed`, so transient stream disconnects retry automatically ([#6431](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6431)).
- Fixed GitHub Copilot extended context window models (Claude Opus 4.7/4.8, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6/5, Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.3 Codex, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.5) to use `contextWindow: 1000000`, preventing premature compaction and under-budgeting ([#6439](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6439)).

### Added

- Added OpenAI GPT-5.6 model metadata for `gpt-5.6`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, and `gpt-5.6-luna`, plus verified `openai-codex` support for `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, and `gpt-5.6-luna`.
- Added provider-side constrained sampling for tools via `Tool.constrainedSampling`: strict JSON-schema enforcement for OpenAI and Anthropic tool calls, and OpenAI custom grammar tools (Lark/regex). Grammar tool capability comes from the model catalog's `supportsGrammarTools` compat flag, enabled for GPT-5+ models on OpenAI, OpenAI Codex, Azure OpenAI, GitHub Copilot, opencode, and Cloudflare AI Gateway ([#6341](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6341)).
- Refreshed generated model catalogs from models.dev, adding newly listed models including Kimi K2.7 Code for GitHub Copilot and Fable 5 to several providers ([#6256](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6256)).
- Added Claude Sonnet 5 to the GitHub Copilot model catalog ([#6200](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6200)).
- Added zstd request-body compression for the OpenAI Codex Responses SSE transport. Requests are sent with `Content-Encoding: zstd` when Node/Bun zstd support is available; the WebSocket transport is unchanged.

zh.body:
### 修复

- 修复了gRPC `ResourceExhausted`提供程序错误的重试分类，例如NVIDIA NIM临时耗尽响应（[#6449](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6449) 由 [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai) 提交）。  
- 修复了底层消息转换，使其在提供程序转换前标准化`null`消息内容，避免在导入的转录文件较宽松时崩溃（[#6343](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6343)）。  
- 修复了小米Token Plan模型元数据，使其遵循models.dev的token-plan目录，移除了不支持的`mimo-v2-omni`变体（[#6204](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6204)）。  
- 修复了GitHub Copilot设备码登录轮询，在首次token轮询前等待，避免在浏览器授权后部分用户出现设备码失败（[#6187](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6187)）。  
- 修复了OAuth设备码轮询，使其尊重服务器提供的`slow_down`间隔，而非仅应用RFC 8628的5秒增量，使GitHub Copilot登录恢复，而非在轮询提前到达时（如WSL/VM时钟漂移）挂起（[#6187](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6187)）。  
- 修复了OpenAI Codex用户代理构建，使其同步加载Node OS元数据，避免启动竞态导致报告`pi (browser)`（在Node/Bun中）。  
- 修复了Fireworks GLM 5.2 Fast，使其使用兼容OpenAI的端点和`thinkingLevelMap`，与GLM 5.2保持一致（[#6195](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6195)）。  
- 修复了Amazon Bedrock Claude Fable 5和Sonnet 5的提示缓存点（[#6235](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6235)）。  
- 修复了Amazon Bedrock Claude 5的提示缓存定价元数据，移除了过期的回退覆盖项。  
- 修复了DS4服务器上下文溢出检测中的`Prompt has ... tokens, but the configured context size is ... tokens`错误（[#6262](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6262)）。  
- 修复了OpenAI Codex WebSocket会话，在后端60分钟限制前轮换缓存连接，避免长时间会话出现连接限制失败（[#6268](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6268)）。  
- 修复了Cloudflare Workers AI/AI Gateway认证，使其在存储凭证仅包含API密钥时回退到环境`CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`（及`CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_ID`），从而解决了仅凭`/login`风格密钥凭证导致`{CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}`占位符未解析返回404的问题（[#6021](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6021)）。  
- 修复了OpenAI完成和响应提供程序，在工具结果为空文本且无图片内容时发送`(no tool output)`而非`(see attached image)`，防止模型虚构图片附件。  
- 修复了OpenAI响应和Azure OpenAI响应请求，避免发送低于提供程序最低值的`max_output_tokens`（[#6265](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6265)）。
- 修复了Cloudflare 524超时响应的重试分类（[#6239](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6239)）。
- 修复了Bun获取socket-drop错误（如`socket connection was closed`）的重试分类，使短暂的流断开连接能够自动重试（[#6431](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6431)）。
- 修复了GitHub Copilot扩展上下文窗口模型（Claude Opus 4.7/4.8，Claude Opus 4.6，Claude Sonnet 4.6/5，Claude Fable 5，GPT-5.3 Codex，GPT-5.4，GPT-5.5）以使用`contextWindow: 1000000`，防止过早压缩和预算不足（[#6439](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6439)）。

### 新增

- 新增了OpenAI GPT-5.6模型的元数据（`gpt-5.6`、`gpt-5.6-sol`、`gpt-5.6-terra`、`gpt-5.6-luna`），并验证了`openai-codex`对`gpt-5.6-sol`、`gpt-5.6-terra`、`gpt-5.6-luna`的支持。
- 新增了通过`Tool.constrainedSampling`对工具的提供方侧约束采样：对OpenAI和Anthropic工具调用严格执行JSON-schema约束，以及OpenAI自定义语法工具（Lark/regex）。语法工具能力来源于模型目录的`supportsGrammarTools`兼容标志，该标志已启用，适用于OpenAI、OpenAI Codex、Azure OpenAI、GitHub Copilot、opencode和Cloudflare AI Gateway上的GPT-5+模型（[#6341](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6341)）。
- 刷新了从models.dev生成的模型目录，新增了包括GitHub Copilot的Kimi K2.7 Code和Fable 5在内的多个提供方的模型（[#6256](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6256)）。
- 将Claude Sonnet 5添加到GitHub Copilot模型目录（[#6200](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6200)）。
- 为OpenAI Codex Responses SSE传输新增了zstd请求体压缩。当Node/Bun支持zstd时，请求会携带`Content-Encoding: zstd`；WebSocket传输保持不变。

en.body:
### New Features

- **Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 support** - Claude Sonnet 5 is available through inherited Anthropic-compatible and Bedrock provider catalogs with adaptive thinking enabled. See [Providers](docs/providers.md) and [Model Options](docs/usage.md#model-options).
- **Configurable output spacing** - `outputPad` controls horizontal padding for user messages, assistant messages, and thinking blocks. See [Settings](docs/settings.md#ui--display).
- **External editor configuration** - `externalEditor` lets Ctrl+G use a configured editor before `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` fallbacks. See [Settings](docs/settings.md#ui--display) and [Keybindings](docs/keybindings.md).
- **Richer RPC session tree access** - RPC clients can inspect session entries and tree snapshots with `get_entries` and `get_tree`. See [get_entries](docs/rpc.md#get_entries) and [get_tree](docs/rpc.md#get_tree).
- **Extension session metadata updates** - Extensions can observe session name changes through `session_info_changed`. See [session_info_changed](docs/extensions.md#session_info_changed).
- **Modern Azure Foundry endpoint support** - Azure OpenAI Responses provider setup supports current Microsoft Foundry endpoint URLs. See [Azure OpenAI](docs/providers.md#azure-openai).

### Added

- Added inherited Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 model support.
- Added `get_entries` and `get_tree` RPC commands for reading session entries and tree snapshots over RPC ([#6078](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6078) by [@geraschenko](https://github.com/geraschenko)).
- Added a package `./rpc-entry` export for launching Pi directly in RPC mode.
- Added session-name change events for extensions ([#6175](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6175) by [@xl0](https://github.com/xl0)).
- Added inherited Azure OpenAI Responses support for modern Microsoft Foundry endpoint URLs ([#6004](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6004) by [@gukoff](https://github.com/gukoff)).
- Added inherited `Usage.reasoning` token counts for providers that report reasoning/thinking token usage ([#6057](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6057)).
- Added an `externalEditor` settings.json override for Ctrl+G external editor commands, with default fallbacks to Notepad on Windows and `nano` elsewhere ([#6122](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6122)).
- Added an `outputPad` setting for user message, assistant message, and thinking horizontal padding ([#6168](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6168)).

### Changed

- Changed the default OpenAI model to `gpt-5.5`.
- Changed inherited OpenAI Codex Responses SSE response-header waits to use the configured HTTP timeout instead of the previous fixed 20 second timeout, reducing false timeouts on slow connections ([#4945](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/4945)).

### Fixed

- Fixed inherited Claude Sonnet 5 metadata to use adaptive thinking payloads for Anthropic-compatible and Bedrock requests.
- Fixed inherited generated Xiaomi MiMo model pricing to match current pay-as-you-go pricing from models.dev ([#6138](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6138)).
- Fixed inherited provider HTTP errors to include response bodies instead of opaque SDK messages ([#5832](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5832) by [@stephanmck](https://github.com/stephanmck)).
- Fixed inherited `streamSimple()` max-token caps so providers that count input and output against one context window do not reject long requests ([#5595](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5595)).
- Fixed inherited OpenAI Responses streams to preserve reasoning replay state when output items finish out of order ([#6009](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6009)).
- Fixed inherited Z.AI preserved thinking requests to send `thinking.clear_thinking: false` when thinking is enabled, allowing replayed `reasoning_content` to participate in provider caching ([#6083](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6083)).
- Fixed pre-prompt compaction to stop after compaction instead of continuing immediately ([#6074](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6074) by [@yzhg1983](https://github.com/yzhg1983)).
- Fixed resource notifications to stay before messages when resuming sessions ([#6048](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6048) by [@haoqixu](https://github.com/haoqixu)).
- Fixed startup benchmark timing output to print after TUI shutdown, preserve extension timings, and drain terminal-query replies before stopping benchmark mode ([#6030](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6030) by [@xl0](https://github.com/xl0), [#6063](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6063) by [@xl0](https://github.com/xl0)).
- Fixed extension tool changes to apply before the next provider request in the same agent run without dropping `before_agent_start` system-prompt overrides ([#6162](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6162)).
- Fixed a crash when undici emits an internal client error while terminating a mid-stream HTTP response ([#6133](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6133)).
- Fixed the compaction event regression test to cover status indicator cleanup and keep CI passing.
- Fixed interactive status indicators so ending work, retry, compaction, or branch-summary indicators no longer shrink the TUI when clear-on-shrink is enabled ([#6026](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6026)).
- Fixed `--session` and `SessionManager.open()` to reject non-empty invalid session files without overwriting them ([#6002](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6002)).
- Fixed user-message transcript rendering to keep visible backslashes in Markdown escape sequences such as `\"` ([#6105](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6105)).
- Fixed assistant messages stopped by output length to show a visible incomplete-response error ([#4290](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/4290)).
- Fixed `--no-session --session-id` so ephemeral CLI runs can use deterministic session IDs for provider cache affinity ([#6070](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6070)).
- Fixed disk BMP image files to be detected, converted to PNG, and attached through `read` and CLI `@file` inputs ([#6047](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6047)).
- Fixed auto-retry for provider stream errors that explicitly tell callers to retry the request ([#6019](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6019)).

sections.title: New Features
sections.body:
- **Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 support** - Claude Sonnet 5 is available through inherited Anthropic-compatible and Bedrock provider catalogs with adaptive thinking enabled. See [Providers](docs/providers.md) and [Model Options](docs/usage.md#model-options).
- **Configurable output spacing** - `outputPad` controls horizontal padding for user messages, assistant messages, and thinking blocks. See [Settings](docs/settings.md#ui--display).
- **External editor configuration** - `externalEditor` lets Ctrl+G use a configured editor before `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` fallbacks. See [Settings](docs/settings.md#ui--display) and [Keybindings](docs/keybindings.md).
- **Richer RPC session tree access** - RPC clients can inspect session entries and tree snapshots with `get_entries` and `get_tree`. See [get_entries](docs/rpc.md#get_entries) and [get_tree](docs/rpc.md#get_tree).
- **Extension session metadata updates** - Extensions can observe session name changes through `session_info_changed`. See [session_info_changed](docs/extensions.md#session_info_changed).
- **Modern Azure Foundry endpoint support** - Azure OpenAI Responses provider setup supports current Microsoft Foundry endpoint URLs. See [Azure OpenAI](docs/providers.md#azure-openai).

zh.body:
### 新功能

- **Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5支持** - Claude Sonnet 5可通过继承的Anthropic兼容和Bedrock提供商目录使用，并启用了自适应思维。请参阅[提供商](docs/providers.md)和[模型选项](docs/usage.md#model-options)。
- **可配置输出间距** - `outputPad`控制用户消息、助手消息和思维块的水平内边距。请参阅[设置](docs/settings.md#ui--display)。
- **外部编辑器配置** - `externalEditor`允许Ctrl+G在`$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR`回退之前使用配置的编辑器。请参阅[设置](docs/settings.md#ui--display)和[快捷键](docs/keybindings.md)。
- **更丰富的RPC会话树访问** - RPC客户端可以使用`get_entries`和`get_tree`检查会话条目和树快照。请参阅[get_entries](docs/rpc.md#get_entries)和[get_tree](docs/rpc.md#get_tree)。
- **扩展会话元数据更新** - 扩展可以通过`session_info_changed`观察会话名称更改。请参阅[session_info_changed](docs/extensions.md#session_info_changed)。
- **现代Azure Foundry端点支持** - Azure OpenAI响应提供商设置支持当前的Microsoft Foundry端点URL。请参阅[Azure OpenAI](docs/providers.md#azure-openai)。

### 增加了

- 增加了继承的Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5模型支持。
- 增加了`get_entries`和`get_tree` RPC命令，用于通过RPC读取会话条目和树快照（[#6078](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6078)由[@geraschenko](https://github.com/geraschenko)提交）。
- 增加了一个`./rpc-entry`包导出，用于直接在RPC模式下启动Pi。
- 增加了会话名称更改事件，供扩展使用（[#6175](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6175)由[@xl0](https://github.com/xl0)提交）。
- 增加了继承的Azure OpenAI响应支持，用于现代Microsoft Foundry端点URL（[#6004](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6004)由[@gukoff](https://github.com/gukoff)提交）。
- 增加了继承的`Usage.reasoning`令牌计数，用于报告推理/思维令牌使用情况的提供商（[#6057](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6057)）。
- 增加了`externalEditor`的settings.json覆盖，用于Ctrl+G外部编辑器命令，默认情况下在Windows上回退到Notepad，在其他地方回退到`nano`（[#6122](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6122)）。
- 增加了`outputPad`设置，用于用户消息、助手消息和思维的水平内边距（[#6168](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6168)）。

### 更改了

- 将默认的OpenAI模型更改为`gpt-5.5`。
- 将继承的OpenAI Codex响应SSE响应头等待更改为使用配置的HTTP超时，而不是之前的固定20秒超时，从而减少了慢连接上的虚假超时（[#4945](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/4945)）。

### 修复了

- 修复了继承的Claude Sonnet 5元数据，使其在Anthropic兼容和Bedrock请求中使用自适应思维负载。
- 修复了继承的生成小米MiMo模型定价，使其与models.dev的当前按使用付费定价匹配（[#6138](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6138)）。
- 修复了继承的提供商HTTP错误，使其包含响应体，而不是不透明的SDK消息（[#5832](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5832)由[@stephanmck](https://github.com/stephanmck)提交）。
-  修复了继承的 `streamSimple()` 最大令牌限制，使那些将输入和输出计数视为同一上下文窗口的提供者不会拒绝长请求（[#5595](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5595)）。
-  修复了继承的 OpenAI 响应流，以保持推理回放状态，即使输出项按顺序完成（[#6009](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6009)）。
-  修复了继承的 Z.AI 保留思考请求，在启用思考时发送 `thinking.clear_thinking: false`，允许回放的 `reasoning_content` 参与提供者缓存（[#6083](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6083)）。
-  修复了预提示压缩，使其在压缩后停止，而不是立即继续（[#6074](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6074) 由 [@yzhg1983](https://github.com/yzhg1983) 提交）。
-  修复了资源通知，在恢复会话时保持在消息之前（[#6048](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6048) 由 [@haoqixu](https://github.com/haoqixu) 提交）。
-  修复了启动基准测试时间输出，使其在 TUI 关闭后打印，保持扩展计时，并在停止基准模式前排空终端查询回复（[#6030](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6030) 由 [@xl0](https://github.com/xl0) 提交，[#6063](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6063) 由 [@xl0](https://github.com/xl0) 提交）。
-  修复了扩展工具更改，在同一代理运行中应用到下一个提供者请求之前，且不会丢失 `before_agent_start` 系统提示覆盖（[#6162](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6162)）。
-  修复了 undici 在终止中间流 HTTP 响应时发出内部客户端错误导致的崩溃（[#6133](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6133)）。
-  修复了压缩事件回归测试，以覆盖状态指示器清理并保持持续集成通过。
-  修复了交互式状态指示器，使结束工作、重试、压缩或分支摘要指示器在启用 clear-on-shrink 时不再缩小 TUI（[#6026](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6026)）。
-  修复了 `--session` 和 `SessionManager.open()`，拒绝非空无效会话文件而不覆盖它们（[#6002](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6002)）。
-  修复了用户消息转录渲染，保持可见的反斜杠，例如在 `\"` 等 Markdown 转义序列中（[#6105](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6105)）。
-  修复了因输出长度停止的助手消息，显示可见的不完整响应错误（[#4290](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/4290)）。
-  修复了 `--no-session --session-id`，使短暂 CLI 运行可以使用确定性会话 ID 进行提供者缓存亲和力（[#6070](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6070)）。
-  修复了磁盘 BMP 图像文件的检测、转换为 PNG 并通过 `read` 和 CLI `@file` 输入附加（[#6047](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6047)）。
-  修复了对提供者流错误的自动重试，这些错误明确告诉调用者重试请求（[#6019](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6019)）。

en.body:
### Added

- Added Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 model metadata for Anthropic-compatible, Bedrock, OpenRouter, and Vercel AI Gateway providers.
- Added Azure OpenAI Responses support for modern Microsoft Foundry endpoint URLs ([#6004](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6004) by [@gukoff](https://github.com/gukoff)).
- Added an optional `reasoning` field to `Usage` reporting reasoning/thinking token counts as a subset of `output`. Populated for Anthropic (`output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens`), OpenAI Responses/Codex/Azure (`output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`), OpenAI Completions (`completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`), and Google Generative AI / Vertex (`thoughtsTokenCount`). Bedrock Converse and Mistral are not populated because those APIs do not return a reasoning token breakdown ([#6057](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6057)).

### Changed

- Changed OpenAI Codex Responses SSE response-header waits to use the configured HTTP timeout instead of the previous fixed 20 second timeout, reducing false timeouts on slow connections ([#4945](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/4945)).

### Fixed

- Fixed Claude Sonnet 5 metadata to use adaptive thinking payloads for Anthropic-compatible and Bedrock requests.
- Fixed generated Xiaomi MiMo model pricing to match current pay-as-you-go pricing from models.dev ([#6138](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6138)).
- Fixed provider HTTP errors to include response bodies instead of opaque SDK messages ([#5832](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5832) by [@stephanmck](https://github.com/stephanmck)).
- Fixed `streamSimple()` to send a context-aware max-token cap so providers that count input and output against one context window do not reject long requests ([#5595](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5595)).
- Fixed OpenAI Responses streams to preserve reasoning replay state when output items finish out of order ([#6009](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6009)).
- Fixed retry classification for provider errors that explicitly tell callers to retry the request ([#6019](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6019)).
- Fixed Z.AI preserved thinking requests to send `thinking.clear_thinking: false` when thinking is enabled, allowing replayed `reasoning_content` to participate in provider caching ([#6083](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6083)).

zh.body:
### 新增

- 新增了Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5模型的元数据，适用于Anthropic兼容、Bedrock、OpenRouter和Vercel AI Gateway提供方。
- 新增了对现代Microsoft Foundry端点URL的Azure OpenAI响应支持（[#6004](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6004)由[@gukoff](https://github.com/gukoff)提交）。
- 新增了一个可选的`reasoning`字段到`Usage`，用于报告`output`中推理/思考令牌计数的子集。该字段已填充Anthropic（`output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens`）、OpenAI Responses/Codex/Azure（`output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`）、OpenAI Completions（`completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`）和Google Generative AI / Vertex（`thoughtsTokenCount`）。Bedrock Converse和Mistral未填充，因为这些API不返回推理令牌细分（[#6057](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6057)）。

### 更改

- 更改了OpenAI Codex Responses SSE响应头等待，使用配置的HTTP超时，而非之前的固定20秒超时，减少了慢连接上的虚假超时（[#4945](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/4945)）。

### 修复

- 修复了Claude Sonnet 5元数据，使其在Anthropic兼容和Bedrock请求中使用自适应思考负载。
- 修复了生成的Xiaomi MiMo模型定价，使其与models.dev当前的按使用付费定价保持一致（[#6138](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6138)）。
- 修复了提供方HTTP错误，使其包含响应体而非晦涩的SDK消息（[#5832](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5832)由[@stephanmck](https://github.com/stephanmck)提交）。
- 修复了`streamSimple()`，使其发送上下文感知的最大令牌限制，以便那些按上下文窗口计算输入和输出的提供方不会拒绝长请求（[#5595](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5595)）。
- 修复了OpenAI Responses流，使其在输出项按顺序完成时仍能保留推理重播状态（[#6009](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6009)）。
- 修复了提供方错误的重试分类，这些错误明确指示调用者应重试请求（[#6019](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6019)）。
- 修复了Z.AI保留的思考请求，在启用思考时发送`thinking.clear_thinking: false`，允许重播的`reasoning_content`参与提供方缓存（[#6083](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6083)）。

### Changed

- Changed inherited pi-ai `ApiKeyCredential` to use the `auth.json`-compatible discriminator `type: "api_key"` and provider-scoped `env` values instead of `type: "api-key"` and metadata.
- Renamed the inherited agent-core public harness shell execution options type from `ExecutionEnvExecOptions` to `ShellExecOptions`.

### Fixed

- Fixed inherited Anthropic-compatible custom models to use explicit compatibility metadata instead of provider-name heuristics for session-affinity headers and unsupported tool-field omissions.
- Fixed inherited request-scoped `apiKey` and `env` values to participate in provider auth resolution, so providers such as Cloudflare can derive request-specific base URLs from explicit call options ([#6021](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6021)).
- Restored inherited temporary legacy per-API stream aliases such as `streamSimpleOpenAICompletions` on the pi-ai compat entrypoint ([#6016](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6016), [#6017](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6017)).
- Restored inherited runtime `detectCompat` fallback in `openai-completions` for models without explicit compat metadata ([#6020](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6020)).

-  恢复了继承的运行时 `detectCompat` 在 `openai-completions` 中的回退，用于没有显式兼容元数据的模型（[#6020](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6020)）。

en.body:
### Changed

- Added `Ctrl+J` as a default newline keybinding alongside `Shift+Enter`.
- Renamed the displayed `zai` provider label to ZAI Coding Plan (Global) for clarity ([#5965](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5965)).
- pi-ai's old global API (`stream`/`complete`/`completeSimple`, `getModel`/`getModels`/`getProviders`, `registerApiProvider`, `getEnvApiKey`, ...) moved off the `@earendil-works/pi-ai` root entrypoint to `@earendil-works/pi-ai/compat`. Extensions are not affected at runtime: the extension loader resolves the pi-ai root to the compat entrypoint (a strict superset), so existing extensions keep working unchanged. Extension sources that typecheck against pi-ai's published types should switch those imports to `@earendil-works/pi-ai/compat` (or migrate to the new `createModels()`/provider-factory API). The compat entrypoint and the loader alias will be removed in a future release with a migration guide.

### Fixed

- Fixed session names to normalize newline characters before storing or displaying labels ([#5999](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5999) by [@haoqixu](https://github.com/haoqixu)).
- Fixed the session selector to order threaded session trees by the latest activity anywhere in each subtree ([#5784](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5784) by [@Perlence](https://github.com/Perlence)).
- Fixed extension-related crash and startup-failure reporting to suggest restarting with `pi -ne`.
- Fixed inherited OpenAI Responses streams to fail before missing terminal events and fixed context usage and compaction estimates to ignore malformed all-zero assistant usage after truncated responses ([#5526](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5526) by [@dmmulroy](https://github.com/dmmulroy)).
- Fixed inherited OpenAI Codex Responses WebSocket sessions to reconnect once when OpenAI's connection limit is reached before output starts ([#5973](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5973)).
- Fixed inherited Amazon Bedrock endpoint resolution to honor scoped `AWS_PROFILE` values.
- Fixed inherited Cloudflare providers to require account/gateway configuration and route built-in compat calls through provider auth.
- Fixed provider-scoped auth environment values to reach inherited `Models`/`ImagesModels` API calls and compat API-key injection.
- Fixed inherited OpenCode Go GLM-5.2 metadata to expose `xhigh` reasoning and send the provider's max reasoning effort ([#5967](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5967)).
- Fixed `pi --resume` to load user package themes and resolve automatic light/dark theme settings.
- Fixed `models.json` custom providers so stored credentials can satisfy auth without a redundant provider-level `apiKey` ([#5953](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5953)).

### Removed

- Removed inherited selective-provider `@earendil-works/pi-ai/base` and `@earendil-works/pi-agent-core/base` entrypoints; use the root packages with explicit `Models` provider factories instead.

zh.body:
### 变更
- 增加了`Ctrl+J`作为默认的换行键绑定，与`Shift+Enter`并列。
- 将显示的`zai`提供商标签重命名为“ZAI Coding Plan (Global)”以提高清晰度（[#5965](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5965)）。
- pi-ai的旧版全局API（`stream`/`complete`/`completeSimple`，`getModel`/`getModels`/`getProviders`，`registerApiProvider`，`getEnvApiKey`，...）已从`@earendil-works/pi-ai`根入口点迁移到`@earendil-works/pi-ai/compat`。运行时扩展不受影响：扩展加载器会将pi-ai根解析为兼容入口点（严格超集），因此现有扩展无需更改即可继续工作。那些类型检查符合pi-ai已发布类型规范的扩展源应将导入切换到`@earendil-works/pi-ai/compat`（或迁移到新的`createModels()`/provider-factory API）。兼容入口点和加载器别名将在后续版本中移除，并附带迁移指南。

### 修复

- 修复了会话名称，使其在存储或显示标签前会规范化换行字符（[#5999](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5999) 由 [@haoqixu](https://github.com/haoqixu) 提交）。
- 修复了会话选择器，使其按每个子树中最新活动对线程会话树进行排序（[#5784](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5784) 由 [@Perlence](https://github.com/Perlence) 提交）。
- 修复了与扩展相关的崩溃和启动失败报告，建议重启时使用`pi -ne`。
- 修复了继承自OpenAI的响应流，使其在缺少终端事件前不会失败，并修复了上下文使用和压缩估算，使其忽略截断响应后全零的助手使用情况（[#5526](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5526) 由 [@dmmulroy](https://github.com/dmmulroy) 提交）。
- 修复了继承自OpenAI Codex的WebSocket会话，在OpenAI连接限制达到前输出开始前仅重新连接一次（[#5973](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5973)）。
- 修复了继承自Amazon Bedrock的端点解析，使其尊重作用域内的`AWS_PROFILE`值。
- 修复了继承自Cloudflare的提供商，使其要求配置账户/网关并路由内置兼容调用通过提供商认证。
- 修复了作用域认证环境值，使其能够达到继承的`Models`/`ImagesModels` API调用和兼容API密钥注入。
- 修复了继承自OpenCode Go GLM-5.2的元数据，使其暴露`xhigh`推理并发送提供商的最大推理努力（[#5967](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5967)）。
- 修复了`pi --resume`以加载用户包主题并解析自动亮/暗主题设置。
- 修复了`models.json`自定义提供商，使其存储的凭证可在认证时满足需求而无需冗余的`apiKey`（[#5953](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5953)）。

### 移除

- 移除了继承自选择性提供商的`@earendil-works/pi-ai/base`和`@earendil-works/pi-agent-core/base`入口点；请改用带有显式`Models`提供商工厂的根包。

en.body:
### Breaking Changes

- `AgentHarnessOptions.models` is required and is the only auth path: the harness streams turns, compaction, and branch summarization through the provided `Models` instance (`models.streamSimple()`/`completeSimple()`), resolving auth through the providers. `AgentHarnessOptions.getApiKeyAndHeaders` is removed — apps that resolved keys per request now express that as provider auth (`ApiKeyAuth`/`OAuthAuth`) on the providers in the `Models` collection. Build one with `createModels()` + provider factories (or `builtinModels()` from `@earendil-works/pi-ai/providers/all`); tests use `fauxProvider()`.
- `compact()`, `generateSummary()`, and `generateBranchSummary()` take a `Models` parameter and no longer accept explicit `apiKey`/`headers`.
- `StreamFn` is defined structurally (`(model, context, options?) => AssistantMessageEventStream | Promise<...>`); `Models.streamSimple` satisfies it.
- Removed the `@earendil-works/pi-agent-core/base` selective-provider entrypoint; use the root package with an explicit `Models` instance instead.

### Fixed

- Fixed harness session names to normalize newline characters before storing labels ([#5999](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5999) by [@haoqixu](https://github.com/haoqixu)).
- Fixed harness compaction estimates to ignore malformed all-zero assistant usage after truncated responses ([#5526](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5526) by [@dmmulroy](https://github.com/dmmulroy)).

### 不兼容变更

- `AgentHarnessOptions.models`为必需且是唯一的认证路径：框架通过提供的`Models`实例（`models.streamSimple()`/`completeSimple()`）处理轮次、压缩和分支摘要，通过提供者进行认证。`AgentHarnessOptions.getApiKeyAndHeaders`已移除——应用现在通过在`Models`集合中的提供者上表达`ApiKeyAuth`/`OAuthAuth`（提供者认证）来实现每次请求解析密钥。使用`createModels()`和提供者工厂构建一个版本（或从`@earendil-works/pi-ai/providers/all`的`builtinModels()`）；测试使用`fauxProvider()`。
- `compact()`、`generateSummary()`和`generateBranchSummary()`接受`Models`参数，不再接受显式的`apiKey`/`headers`。
- 结构上定义了`StreamFn`（`(model, context, options?) => AssistantMessageEventStream | Promise<...>`）；`Models.streamSimple`满足该定义。
- 移除了`@earendil-works/pi-agent-core/base`选择性提供者入口点；使用根包和显式的`Models`实例代替。

### 修复
-  修复了 harness 会话名称，使其在存储标签前会标准化换行符 ([#5999](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5999) 由 [@haoqixu](https://github.com/haoqixu) 提交)。

-  修复了 harness 压缩估算，使其忽略截断响应后所有零值辅助使用记录的异常情况 ([#5526](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/5526) 由 [@dmmulroy](https://github.com/dmmulroy) 提交)。
